nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty Under Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no redness or irritation from the patches, including one who calls this a huge plus.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, hard-to-moisturize under-eyes reports the hyaluronic acid content added noticeable hydration.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the patches leave the under-eye area feeling hydrated, smoother, or softer, sometimes citing the hyaluronic acid; a few instead describe the effect as only mild cooling with no lasting moisture noticed.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the patches helped with redness under the eyes; several others with sensitive skin report no irritation-related redness at all.

extraits.texte: I love these under-eye masks! They feel cool and refreshing as soon as I apply them. After using them, my eyes look less puffy, brighter and more refreshed. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any redness or irritation while using them, which is a huge plus! The quality is excellent—the masks are durable and don't tear or break when applying. The size is just right for the under-eye area, covering well without feeling too big or too small.

These feel super cooling and refreshing on the skin and didn't cause any irritation to my sensitive skin. Plus they're super cute and made my self care day feel extra luxurious! I would by then again, but maybe in a multipack.

Amazing product, just love it, goes very well sensitive skin, love the design so funny to put it on under eyes, OMG, the way it works just amazing, all the puffness under the saggy eyes will gone in just 15 minutes, this patches become A must product on my cosmetic bag, Thank you little cute kitty eye patches, of forget to mention, the cooling effect from the just is just outstanding

What I like most about these eye patches are the hyaluronic acid to help add hydration to a part of my face that is difficult to keep smooth and moisturized. Additionally, the caffeine provides added benefits for depuffing!
This is the best and cutest under eye patches. It did wonders for my puffy under eyes and redness

This is a rather gimmicky product that's great for Hello Kitty fans. I put the eye patches on and my partner gave me one look and said it would be awful if the decals were left as tattoos. They are cute and playful but the packaging is a lot of plastic and from an eco-friendly standpoint I feel better using my eye roller. They contain caffeine and are moisturizing especially during the allergy seasons when puffy eyes come out. I found them cooling and a nice treat but they don't work miracles. Overall they are on par with most products like this I have used before.

These under eye patches are super cute and easy to put on. However, I felt like that didn't do much for my under eye area. They felt cool which would be nice to use at the end of a hot day either morning or afternoon skin care regime in the summer.
